description: Closed action and reason vocabulary for the read-only workspace_initiative_status coordinator surface. This descriptor is durable data consumed by later initiative-status derivation code. It defines compact advisory action output and does not grant authority to write records, dispatch roles, run lint, refresh metrics, persist graph evidence, or enforce policy.

advisory_contract.action_semantics: Actions are recommendations for which structured repo/wiki tool a coordinator may call next. The initiative-status surface itself must not perform the operation named by an action kind.
advisory_contract.authority_boundary: This file is only the local initiative-status action vocabulary. Runtime blocker codes remain owned by runtime-blocker-codes.v1 and may be referenced only by code in the fields listed under runtime_blocker_references.

runtime_blocker_references.rule: Do not copy or redefine runtime-blocker taxonomy codes here. When runtime blockers influence an advisory action, keep action.reason_code set to an initiative-status-local reason code and carry runtime taxonomy codes only by string reference in the allowed fields.

tie_break_rules: Sort target_unit lexicographically by the canonical unit address, with a parent unit before one of its slice units.
For sibling slices, sort by the literal slice id string; do not infer numeric order from prose.
When all other fields match, sort by stable action id so repeated calls produce deterministic output.

action_kinds.label: Validate record
action_kinds.default_description: Record shape needs validation before a lifecycle action.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use when canonical WK JSON appears invalid, stale, or structurally incomplete. The initiative-status surface only recommends validation; it must not rewrite the record or reinterpret validation diagnostics.

action_kinds.label: Dispatch worker
action_kinds.default_description: Implementation unit appears ready for worker dispatch.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use when a WK or slice is independently executable, unblocked, and shaped for implementation. This action does not dispatch a worker; coordinators must call the structured dispatch tool and monitor the run separately.

action_kinds.label: Dispatch review
action_kinds.default_description: Implementation work appears to need findings-only review.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use when an implementation unit has landed changes or moved toward review and the mandatory findings-only review remains outstanding. The action must target a review-shaped unit or tell the coordinator to create one first.

action_kinds.label: Dispatch redteam
action_kinds.default_description: Design or authority risk appears to need redteam review.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use for architecture, protocol, authority, or high-risk design changes where redteam is required by the WK or risk posture. This action only points to structured redteam dispatch.

action_kinds.label: Record review result
action_kinds.default_description: A completed trusted review result appears ready to record.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use when a trusted reviewer or redteam run has completed and its accepted review-attestation evidence should be recorded. Non-completion review-result evidence is owned by the review-attestation substrate and must not be treated as clean-review attestation.

action_kinds.label: Create remediation slice
action_kinds.default_description: Review or validation findings appear to require scoped remediation work.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use when changes_requested, blocked, failed, or validation evidence indicates new implementation work is needed. The action recommends creating or selecting a scoped implementation unit; it must not edit the tracker itself.

action_kinds.label: Mark slice done
action_kinds.default_description: Slice appears ready for done status after closure and review.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use when a slice has completed implementation, validation, closure, and mandatory review evidence. The status write remains a separate structured work-record setter call.

action_kinds.label: Close parent
action_kinds.default_description: Parent tracker appears ready to close.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use when all required child slices are resolved and the parent has a coherent closure story. The action does not update parent status or closure fields.

action_kinds.label: Generate and lint
action_kinds.default_description: Generated views may need refresh before lint.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use after structural wiki changes where generated views should be refreshed and linted. Repo-wide lint findings are diagnostic unless the selected WK owns the affected lint surface.

action_kinds.label: Run lint
action_kinds.default_description: Read-only repo lint appears useful for verification.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use for read-only validation when generated views do not need refresh. The initiative-status surface must not run lint itself or absorb unrelated repo-wide findings into the selected WK.

action_kinds.label: Refresh admission metrics
action_kinds.default_description: Worker-admission derived evidence appears stale or missing.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use when dispatch readiness or Node Engine admission evidence is absent, stale, or target metrics need rematerialization. Refreshing metrics is a separate structured write-capable operation.

action_kinds.label: Record graph impact
action_kinds.default_description: Graph-impact evidence appears required or stale.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use when a unit requires graph-impact evidence and a trusted graph-impact query should be persisted. The initiative-status surface must not query or write graph evidence itself.

action_kinds.label: Resolve runtime blocker
action_kinds.default_description: A runtime or operator blocker appears to be preventing progress.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use when structured diagnostics expose runtime-blocker taxonomy codes such as missing transport, backend unavailable, read-only mount, or review transport failure. Runtime-blocker codes are referenced by code only and remain defined in runtime-blocker-codes.v1.

action_kinds.label: Split work
action_kinds.default_description: The current unit appears too broad or not independently executable.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use when scope, write_scope, acceptance, target evidence, or atomicity checks indicate the coordinator should narrow or split work before dispatch. The action must preserve WK lifecycle boundaries and does not create slices itself.

action_kinds.label: No action
action_kinds.default_description: No coordinator action is currently suggested.
action_kinds.verbose_description: Use for done, parked, cancelled, or otherwise settled units, or when the compact action lens finds no structured next step. This is not proof that all external systems are healthy.

local_reason_codes.label: Record invalid
local_reason_codes.description: Canonical WK JSON failed or appears likely to fail structured validation.

local_reason_codes.label: Validation needed
local_reason_codes.description: A lifecycle transition or structural edit needs explicit work-record validation.

local_reason_codes.label: Dispatch blocked
local_reason_codes.description: Structured dispatch readiness reports the unit is not launchable. Runtime-blocker taxonomy codes, if present, must be carried only through runtime blocker reference fields.

local_reason_codes.label: Worker ready
local_reason_codes.description: Implementation work appears independently executable and ready for structured worker dispatch.

local_reason_codes.label: Review required
local_reason_codes.description: Mandatory findings-only review appears outstanding for an implementation unit.

local_reason_codes.label: Redteam required
local_reason_codes.description: Risk posture or WK contract indicates redteam review should happen before implementation proceeds.

local_reason_codes.label: Review result ready
local_reason_codes.description: A trusted review or redteam run result appears ready for bounded review-attestation recording.

local_reason_codes.label: Remediation required
local_reason_codes.description: Review, redteam, validation, or derived evidence indicates implementation remediation is needed before closure.

local_reason_codes.label: Slice ready
local_reason_codes.description: A slice appears to have the closure, validation, and review evidence needed for a coordinator status update.

local_reason_codes.label: Parent ready
local_reason_codes.description: The parent tracker appears ready for closure after child units have settled.

local_reason_codes.label: Generate needed
local_reason_codes.description: Structural wiki changes appear to require generated views and lint verification.

local_reason_codes.label: Lint needed
local_reason_codes.description: Read-only repo lint appears useful for verification or caveat classification.

local_reason_codes.label: Validation failed
local_reason_codes.description: Structured validation failed. Runtime-blocker taxonomy codes may be referenced only when the failure originated from that taxonomy.

local_reason_codes.label: Admission metrics needed
local_reason_codes.description: Worker-admission derived evidence appears stale, absent, or incomplete for the selected unit.

local_reason_codes.label: Graph impact needed
local_reason_codes.description: Graph-impact evidence appears required, absent, stale, or blocked by degraded graph state.

local_reason_codes.label: Runtime blocker
local_reason_codes.description: A runtime or operator blocker from runtime-blocker-codes.v1 is present. The local reason code stays stable while the taxonomy code is referenced separately.

local_reason_codes.label: Split needed
local_reason_codes.description: The selected work unit appears too broad, crosses lifecycle boundaries, or lacks bounded target evidence.

local_reason_codes.label: Scope mismatch
local_reason_codes.description: Requested initiative and unit scope do not align, or the unit's declared scope contradicts the coordinator action being considered.

local_reason_codes.label: No pending action
local_reason_codes.description: No structured coordinator action is currently suggested by the initiative-status lens.

local_reason_codes.label: Closed or inactive
local_reason_codes.description: The target unit is done, parked, cancelled, or otherwise not awaiting an initiative-status action.

output_guidance.compact_label_budget: Labels should remain short enough for bounded default top_actions output.
output_guidance.selected_action_mode: Verbose descriptions, evidence references, suggested parameters, and caveats are available only when a caller asks for selected-action or verbose/progressive-disclosure output.
